name: com.thefinestartist.finestwebview.FinestWebViewActivity
description: The FinestWebView library is a general-purpose in-app browser: the app gives it a URL, and it displays the page with a title, loading progress, navigation, refresh, and options to copy, share, or open the link in another browser.
disableEffect: The app cannot open pages through this browser, so any app flow routed through it will be unavailable.
